name: BigQuery
fit: Large analytical scans, aggregations and joins.
signal: Warehouse queries across many records.
caution: Per-request point lookups need a separate latency assessment.

name: Bigtable
fit: High-throughput keyed and time-series serving.
signal: Read a sensor or entity by a designed row-key range.
caution: Do not assume arbitrary warehouse-style joins are its main access path.

name: Cloud SQL
fit: Managed MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server applications.
signal: Relational transactions with existing engine compatibility.
caution: Size, connection limits and availability still need a deliberate design.

name: Spanner
fit: Distributed relational transactions and strong consistency.
signal: Scale transactional data while preserving the required consistency model.
caution: Model keys and transaction scope; the service name alone is not the schema.

name: AlloyDB
fit: Demanding PostgreSQL-compatible workloads.
signal: Preserve PostgreSQL tooling while using a managed database architecture.
caution: Verify compatibility and workload economics rather than assuming a free migration.

name: Firestore
fit: Document-oriented application data.
signal: Read and update application entities through a document model.
caution: Design indexes and transactions against the actual document access pattern.

name: Cloud Storage
fit: Durable objects and reusable lake files.
signal: Keep files independent of the processing cluster.
caution: Object storage alone is not a relational transaction engine.

name: BigLake tables
fit: Governed queries over supported external objects.
signal: Delegate storage access through a connection and enforce table-level controls.
caution: A catalog entry alone does not create this delegated access model.

name: Memorystore
fit: An in-memory cache or supported Redis workload.
signal: Serve frequently reused application state with a suitable availability tier.
caution: Decide explicitly whether cached values are recoverable from a durable source.

name: Dataflow
fit: Managed Beam execution for bounded and streaming pipelines.
signal: Custom transforms, event-time processing and controlled error outputs.
caution: Check runner behavior, source/sink limits and stateful update compatibility.

name: Pub/Sub
fit: Decoupled event transport and subscription delivery.
signal: Producers and consumers need independent scaling and availability.
caution: Delivery, per-key ordering, replay and external side effects are different contracts.

name: Dataproc / managed Spark
fit: Existing Spark and Hadoop ecosystems.
signal: Preserve execution compatibility during a short migration.
caution: Separate durable objects from temporary cluster storage and compare idle compute.

name: Dataform
fit: Versioned BigQuery SQL dependency graphs and assertions.
signal: Warehouse ELT, incremental models and quality gates.
caution: Test that the required assertion is a true dependency of publication.

name: Cloud Data Fusion
fit: Visual integration and data preparation pipelines.
signal: A team needs supported connectors and a graphical transformation interface.
caution: A format conversion alone does not cleanse invalid values.

name: Cloud Composer / managed Airflow
fit: Multi-step dependency graphs, schedules and task-level recovery.
signal: Workflows need independently observable retries and reruns.
caution: Use logical run intervals and idempotent task effects; an environment is not free idle compute.

name: Workflows
fit: Lightweight serverless service-call coordination.
signal: A sequence of API calls and conditions should run without an Airflow environment.
caution: The orchestration layer does not perform every large data transformation itself.

name: Datastream
fit: Supported database change capture and replication.
signal: Backfill plus ongoing updates should feed a supported target.
caution: Verify the source engine, change semantics, connectivity and cutover contract.

name: Storage Transfer Service
fit: Managed movement of supported object and file data.
signal: Recurring file transfer is the requirement.
caution: It does not automatically replace a database CDC extractor or transform arbitrary proprietary formats.

name: Knowledge Catalog / guide: Dataplex
fit: Metadata discovery, lineage and governed data context.
signal: Domain products need discoverability and shared guardrails.
caution: Catalog entries are not a substitute for underlying data permissions or quality evidence.

name: Sensitive Data Protection
fit: Inspection and supported de-identification of sensitive values.
signal: Data must be inspected or transformed under a privacy contract.
caution: Masking, irreversible transformations and reversible tokenization have different requirements.

name: Cloud Monitoring
fit: Metrics and actionable alert policies.
signal: Detect data freshness, backlog or resource symptoms with an owner and runbook.
caution: A healthy CPU chart does not prove business data completeness.

name: Cloud Logging / Audit Logs
fit: Operational logs and evidence of relevant access or administration.
signal: Investigate who did what and correlate processing failures.
caution: Check applicable log type, configuration, retention and sensitive payload handling.
